extraction_notes: Target identity retained exactly: SI2302S, GOODWORK, n-channel MOSFET. This is the supplied GOODWORK datasheet, not the FOSAN SI2302S or any SI2301 p-channel part.

The supplied PDF title metadata is SS1100, while the printed datasheet title is SI2302S N-channel Enhancement Mode Power MOSFET. The printed revision is REV 1.0 2021 JAN and the document contains five pages.
The VGS(th) table publishes MIN = 0.5 V and MAX = 1.0 V at VDS = VGS and ID = 250 mA; the TYP column is blank and is represented as null. The unusual 250 mA condition is preserved exactly as printed.

RDS(ON) rows are transcribed as inclusive maximum values: 60 mOhm at VGS = 4.5 V and ID = 3 A, and 90 mOhm at VGS = 2.5 V and ID = 2 A. Both rows retain Note 3 pulse conditions of pulse width <= 300 us and duty cycle <= 0.5%.
The capacitance table publishes Ciss = 200 pF, Coss = 35 pF, and Crss = 28 pF with VGS = 0 V, VDS = 10 V, and f = 1 MHz. Values are converted to farads.

Curves are compact direct readings from the supplied plots on p. 3. The 25 degC transfer and body-diode curves are selected where the figure provides temperature families. No points were generated by interpolation between source values. Capacitance plot values are converted from pF to F and retain the plotted logarithmic y-axis.

Additional tabulated fields not represented by the strict schema include absolute maximum ratings, IDSS, IGSS, gate charge, switching times, reverse-recovery data, thermal resistance, and temperature-dependent rating curves; they are not mapped into unrelated schema fields.
